messages.text: seeing a bunch of `flagctl set` changes with reasons like `test` and `x` again. can we tighten that up? feels like we need an INC or ticket id in `--reason` at least.

replies.text: yeah, I've been seeing that too. the audit trail is basically useless if the reason is one char.
agree. we can probably validate format in flagctl client, and maybe on the server side too so it's not bypassable.

messages.text: while we're at it, can payouts flags page @payouts-eng when changed? those flips matter and we keep finding out after the fact.

replies.text: yeah, that sounds reasonable. page on any change, or only when `payouts.*` flags move?
only `payouts.*`. if it's `payouts.writes_paused` or `payouts.batch_enabled`, I want a heads up in `#oncall-payouts`.

messages.text: for the reason thing, I'd rather not force just ticket ids. lots of legit changes come from incidents. maybe allow `INC-1234` or `PLAT-123` or `FEED-9`, but require one of those prefixes.

replies.text: yep. something like `^(INC|PLAT|MEDIA|FEED|EDGE|PAY|SEC)-\d+` as a substring check. not perfect, but better than `test`.

messages.text: could also make `--reason` accept free text but require the first token to be an id. helps keep it readable, like `PLAT-3812 pause feeds writes during rollback`.

replies.text: first token works for me. easier to teach too.

messages.text: there's also the question of old scripts. we have a few cron-ish wrappers that set flags with static reasons. if we gate this too hard, we may break them.

replies.text: we can do warn-only for a week? then hard fail. and send a Slack nudge to `#flags` when it happens.

messages.text: re payouts paging, I don't think we need to page on every write to the flag. only on actual value change, and probably not if the value is set to the same thing again.

replies.text: good point. page on diff, ignore no-op sets.
exactly. we've got enough noise already.

messages.text: I can take the CLI validation. flagctl can reject empty / short reasons and print a hint with examples. server side check maybe in the flag API too.

replies.text: I can do the API side. should be quick, just need to make sure the response is clear enough for folks using the web UI later.

messages.text: for the payouts page, maybe send to `#oncall-payouts` and @payouts-eng if it's an actual change. do we want a bot message or an @here?

replies.text: bot message to `#oncall-payouts` is enough, plus `@payouts-eng` if you can do group mentions cleanly. don't need full `@here`.

messages.text: I like the idea of requiring a ticket or incident id, but we should allow `SEC-` too. security might flip flags during reviews and I don't want them blocked.

replies.text: yeah, list is fine. can keep it to the prefixes we already use everywhere else.

messages.text: ok, sounds like: 1) require id prefix in `--reason`, 2) warn then enforce, 3) page `#oncall-payouts` and `@payouts-eng` on actual `payouts.*` changes. I'll write this up in an ADR and add a ticket.

replies.text: nice. drop the ADR number here when it's up and I'll keep an eye on the payouts paging bit.
